exposure: Pre-induction cervical ripening agent (mifepristone vs. misoprostol)
cohort: 250 women at term (37-40 weeks gestation) admitted for induction of labor.
finding: The study aims to determine if there is a significant difference in the improvement of cervical ripening scores and labor outcomes between mifepristone and misoprostol when used as pre-induction cervical ripening agents in term pregnancies.
